==Overview==
The Steward of Bears Rest is a [[Wintermark]] [[Imperial title]] [[Construct_Bears_Rest|commissioned]] by the Imperial Senate in Summer 388YE.
==Responsibilities==
The Steward of Bears Rest has no particular responsibilities; they simply receive a bounty of [[Game_items#Mana_Crystals|crystal mana]]. If Bears Rest were to be threatened in any way, it would be the responsibility of the Steward to deal with those threats.
==Powers==
===Bounty of Mana===
The Steward of Bears Rest gains custodianship of a [[sinecure]]. They receive an income of 9 crystal mana each season.
==Appointment== 
The Steward of Bears Rest is appointed by unanimous decision of the [[Wintermark]] [[senator|senators]]. If a unanimous decision cannot be reached, the title [[Appointments_by_the_Senate#National_Position|may be appointed]] by the [[Senate]] instead. 

The title can be held by a Wintermark citizen. The Steward has [[tenure]], and serves until they die or step down. They can be [[revocation|revoked]] by the [[Assembly#General_Assembly|General Assembly]], the Wintermark [[Assembly#The_National_Assemblies|National Assembly]], and by the [[Assembly#Assembly_of_the_Nine|Assembly of the Nine]].
